text: In the 24000-step N=128 seed-21 run, force at step 12000 (about 0.754) is 0.013 below the 12000-step run's endpoint (0.766), yet it finishes 0.020 above it. If force is compared at matched schedule fractions of the two runs (step 6000 of 12000 vs step 12000 of 24000, and both endpoints), is the difference mostly a constant low-lr-tail bonus of about 0.01-0.02? Or does the longer run really keep gaining force?
